summary: HyOrc Corporation filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing a November 2, 2026 Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release with Daniel S. McKinney and Coldway Limited, LLC, resolving Nevada litigation (Case No. A-26-955028-C) that sought over $3 million and concerned affiliate/control classifications on transfer agent Transfer Online's records. The action is dismissed with prejudice against five director defendants, with mutual releases and no fee award. HyOrc will instruct Transfer Online to remove affiliate designations for McKinney and Coldway per a May 20, 2026 opinion letter. This is a litigation settlement, not a special situation; watch for any residual 144 resale overhang.
